security_audit.summary: Both static findings are false positives after context review. The detected backticks are a Markdown code fence for an event naming pattern, and the container reference is GA4/GTM guidance, not system reconnaissance.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 229 is a Markdown code fence around the event naming pattern object_action[_context]. There is no Ruby shell backtick execution or command invocation.
The phrase avoids multiple containers in GA4 and GTM implementation guidance. It refers to tag manager containers, not host, Docker, or system reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Teams often collect analytics data that cannot support decisions. This skill audits measurement quality and creates practical tracking plans for reliable insight.
actual_capabilities: Calculates a Measurement Readiness Index with clear readiness bands.
Designs event taxonomies with names, properties, triggers, and supported decisions.
Audits conversion definitions, counting rules, and funnel stages.
Lists validation checks for duplicate events, mobile behavior, consent state, and attribution.
Produces a measurement strategy summary, tracking plan, conversions table, and implementation notes.
limitations: Does not connect to GA4, GTM, Mixpanel, or Amplitude accounts by itself.
Requires current events, business goals, and implementation context for accurate recommendations.
Does not replace legal review for privacy, consent, or retention obligations.
Cannot verify live data unless the user provides test results or access details.

use_cases.title: Audit Campaign Tracking
use_cases.description: Audit conversion data, identify gaps, and prioritize fixes before using campaign reports for budget decisions.

use_cases.title: Design Product Events
use_cases.description: Create a clean event model that links product actions to activation, retention, and conversion questions.

use_cases.title: Plan Tracking Governance
use_cases.description: Document implementation notes, validation steps, and ownership so tracking changes can ship with less rework.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Tracking Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of an existing analytics setup.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess our analytics setup using the Measurement Readiness Index. Ask for missing context, score each category, and list the highest priority fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Design Event Taxonomy
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for a new funnel or feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an event taxonomy for this workflow. Include event names, properties, triggers, conversions, and the decision each event supports.

prompt_templates.title: Audit GA4 and GTM Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before reporting or optimization.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit our GA4 and GTM tracking plan. Find duplicate events, weak conversions, missing properties, attribution risks, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create Measurement Governance Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced operating model for ongoing analytics quality.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a measurement governance plan. Define ownership, versioning, documentation, consent checks, release validation, and monitoring routines.

output_examples.input: Review a SaaS signup funnel before a GA4 migration.
output: Top risks: unclear signup conversion, duplicate form events, and missing consent-state testing.
Next steps: define conversion counting, clean event names, and validate mobile signup paths.

output_examples.input: Build a tracking plan for a new checkout flow.
output: Recommended events include checkout_started, payment_method_selected, purchase_completed, and error_occurred.
Each event includes trigger logic, required properties, and a decision it supports.
Conversions should use purchase_completed with documented counting rules.

output_examples.input: Audit UTM and attribution rules for paid campaigns.
output: Findings include inconsistent source names and overwritten client-side UTMs.
Recommendations include lowercase rules, a shared naming table, and preserved first-touch context.

best_practices: Start with decisions and business questions before naming events.
Use fewer events with clear properties and documented ownership.
Validate real-time firing, duplicate behavior, consent state, and mobile paths before launch.
anti_patterns: Tracking every click without a decision it supports.
Treating dashboard numbers as accurate before instrumentation is tested.
Using conversions for weak actions such as page views or form starts.

faq.question: Which analytics tools does this skill support?
faq.answer: It provides guidance for GA4, GTM, Mixpanel, Amplitude, and similar event-based analytics systems.

faq.question: Does it install tracking code?
faq.answer: No. It designs plans, audits logic, and defines validation steps for implementation teams.

faq.question: Can it improve conversion reporting?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks whether conversions represent real value and whether counting rules are documented.

faq.question: Does it handle privacy requirements?
faq.answer: It prompts for consent, minimization, deletion, and retention considerations. It does not replace legal review.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide business questions, current events, conversions, tools, known data issues, and compliance constraints.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
